subject: Discovery recap: decision owners, PO path, and 60-day pilot timing
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@acmecorp.com>, Tom Lopez <tom.lopez@acmeprocurement.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap: decision owners, PO path, and 60-day pilot timing

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned on next steps and owners before we spin up the pilot: 

Key outcomes from today’s call:
- Economic owner: agreed we should confirm who will sign and own P&L for the pilot (you mentioned CFO involvement).
- Security intake: Acme needs a short security questionnaire and SOC2 evidence before pilot access.
- Procurement: Tom, you mentioned a vendor onboarding portal and a standard PO path.
- Timeline: target to start the 60-day pilot the week of Jan 11, 2027, pending PO/vendor intake.

Immediate asks (can you confirm by EOD Monday?):
1) Confirm economic owner who will sign or approve budget (name & email).
2) Confirm the correct procurement contact and whether the vendor portal link is required.
3) Any required vendor paperwork we should pre-fill (W9, bank form, vendor questionnaire).

I’ve attached a draft SOW (SOW_v0.1.pdf) and a short pilot plan. Monica (cc) will coordinate procurement docs and finance items. Rishi will own the security questionnaire and can expedite evidence.

Appreciate the quick confirmation so we can lock dates.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW_v0.1.pdf (13KB, summary SOW)

From: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@acmecorp.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Lopez <tom.lopez@acmeprocurement.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, legal@acmecorp.com
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 12:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: decision owners, PO path, and 60-day pilot timing

Aditya —

Thanks for the clear summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Economic owner: Ellen Park (CFO) will own the budget and sign the final contract. Ellen's email: ellen.park@acmecorp.com.
2) Procurement contact: Tom (cc) is the right person for PO and vendor intake. We do have an onboarding portal for vendors; Tom will confirm whether you should create an account or we can add you directly.
3) Vendor paperwork: we need a completed vendor intake form, W9, and bank details (for ACH). We typically require the PO before enabling access for pilots.
4) Security: legal@acmecorp.com will route the security questionnaire to our InfoSec team; they typically want SOC2 Type II report and an answer key for a short ~12 question intake.

Pilot timing: Jan 11 pilot start is plausible, but we’ll need PO + intake completed by Jan 6 to provision seats.

Tom — can you confirm the portal link and whether we should expect a standard 30-day net on the PO?

Best,
Sarah
VP, Product
AcmeCorp

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@acmecorp.com>, Tom Lopez <tom.lopez@acmeprocurement.com>, Ellen Park <ellen.park@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: decision owners, PO path, and 60-day pilot timing

Hi Sarah / Tom / Ellen —

Thanks for the confirmation, Sarah. I’ve attached the vendor intake form pre-filled with our details and a bank details form we can return completed.

Attachments included:
- vendor_intake_form.xlsx (pre-filled vendor profile for Acme procurement)
- bank_details_form.pdf (for ACH info)
- ACME_PO_Template.docx (we can accept your PO or we can sign Acme’s template)

Short answers to help your procurement queue: 
- We can accept a standard PO (our finance team prefers net-30 but is flexible if needed for enterprise customers).
- If you prefer to create an account in your vendor portal, send the portal URL and the account request owner and we’ll register immediately.
- For security evidence, Rishi will follow up directly with InfoSec and can provide SOC2 artifacts + short intake answers within 48 hours of access to the questionnaire.

Proposed next steps and owners:
1) Tom: confirm portal link and whether you can add redwoodinference@redwoodinference.com as a vendor admin.
2) Ellen: once you (or a delegate) confirm PO routing and expected issuance date, share estimated PO date.
3) Aditya / Monica: will prepare finalized SOW and pilot acceptance criteria.
4) Rishi: will send security intake answers and SOC2 link (target Tue).

If Jan 11 is still the target for pilot start, we’re asking for PO issuance by Jan 6. If procurement timing looks later, we can prepare a short non-production access (read-only) demo to unblock product evaluation sooner.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the bank form once you confirm preferred routing.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vendor_intake_form.xlsx, bank_details_form.pdf, ACME_PO_Template.docx

From: Tom Lopez <tom.lopez@acmeprocurement.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Ellen Park <ellen.park@acmecorp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: decision owners, PO path, and 60-day pilot timing

Monica / team —

Thanks — quick logistics: 
- Portal: please register here: https://vendors.acmecorp.com/register (preferred). If you reply with the vendor email to add, we can pre-approve.
- PO timing: our finance team expects to issue a PO by Jan 4 if we receive vendor intake + W9 + bank details by Dec 20. Otherwise the next batch is Jan 20.
- Payment terms: standard is net-30. If you need accelerated terms, flag with Marissa and we can discuss.
- Required docs: W9, vendor_intake_form.xlsx (you attached), ACH info, and a signed SOW.

I’ve attached our PO template and a short vendor checklist — I’ll also open a vendor portal ticket to get your company pre-approved.

Tom Lopez
Procurement Manager, Vendor Operations
AcmeCorp
